components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action on a screen: create a contact, save, connect the database.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; background: var(--bosco, #123a2b); color: #f4efe2; border: 1px solid var(--bosco, #123a2b); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.56rem 0.95rem; font: 500 0.9rem/1.2 Archivo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--bosco-mid, #1c5942); border-color: var(--bosco-mid, #1c5942); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bosco-mid, #1c5942); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: transparent; border-color: rgba(20,29,23,0.22); color: #5d6a60; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions that must not compete: export, import, unlink.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #141d17); border: 1px solid rgba(20,29,23,0.22); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.56rem 0.95rem; font: 500 0.9rem/1.2 Archivo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #5d6a60; background: rgba(20,29,23,0.03); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bosco-mid, #1c5942); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with a small uppercase label above it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.28rem; font-family: Archivo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5d6a60; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--field, #fffdf8); color: var(--ink, #141d17); border: 1px solid rgba(20,29,23,0.22); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.62rem 0.7rem; font: 400 0.94rem/1.4 Archivo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--bosco, #123a2b); transition: border-color 0.14s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5d6a60; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--bosco-mid, #1c5942); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(28,89,66,0.16); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category and status filters, sitting above the list they scope.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; background: transparent; color: #47534a; border: 1px solid rgba(20,29,23,0.22); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.32rem 0.6rem; font: 400 0.79rem/1.3 Archivo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.14s ease, color 0.14s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #5d6a60; color: #141d17; } .ds-chip-active { background: var(--bosco, #123a2b); border-color: var(--bosco, #123a2b); color: #f4efe2; } .ds-chip-count { font-size: 0.76rem; opacity: 0.72; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Rail Navigation Item
components.description: Desktop navigation on the evergreen shell, icon plus label.
components.html: RegiaContatti
components.css: .ds-rail { display: grid; gap: 0.15rem; background: var(--bosco, #123a2b); padding: 1.2rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Archivo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; padding: 0.52rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; color: rgba(239,233,220,0.82); font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav:hover { background: rgba(239,233,220,0.08); color: #fffdf6; } .ds-nav-active { background: rgba(239,233,220,0.13); color: #fffdf6; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9a869; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: A sheet of paper holding one block of work. Never nested.
components.html:
Conto della festa

Impegnati 1.000 € su 3.000 € disponibili.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: grid; gap: 1rem; background: var(--sheet, #fbf8f1); border: 1px solid rgba(20,29,23,0.12); border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.25rem 1.3rem; font-family: Archivo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font: 600 0.95rem/1.4 Archivo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; color: #141d17; } .ds-panel-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #47534a; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: The signature: label, dotted leader, right-aligned tabular figure; totals close with a double rule.
components.html:
Disponibile
3.000 €
Restano
2.000 €
components.css: .ds-ledger { display: grid; margin: 0; font-family: Archivo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(1.5rem, 1fr) auto; align-items: baseline; column-gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.55rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(20,29,23,0.12); } .ds-row dt { font-size: 0.92rem; color: #47534a; } .ds-leader { align-self: center; border-bottom: 1px dotted rgba(20,29,23,0.36); } .ds-row dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.02rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; color: #141d17; } .ds-row-total { border-top: 1px solid #141d17; border-bottom: 3px double rgba(20,29,23,0.36); padding-top: 0.7rem; } .ds-row-total dt { font-family: Spectral, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #141d17; } .ds-row-total dd { font-family: Spectral, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

components.name: Status Mark
components.description: Contact state as a drawn square plus a small uppercase word — form and text, never colour alone.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; font: 600 0.73rem/1.3 Archivo, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #47534a; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-status-on { color: #1c5942; } .ds-status-on::before { background: currentColor; } .ds-status-off { color: #5d6a60; }

narrative.overview: This is a sheet kept in the house, not a dashboard sold to a company. Every screen behaves like a printed account: a heading in a book serif, rows that align down a right edge, hairline rules instead of floating panels, and a total that closes the page with a double rule. The material is paper and ink: ivory ground, a deep green shell, brass reserved for provenance and forecast, brick reserved for money that has gone wrong. Depth is almost absent; what separates one thing from another is a 1px rule, a change of paper tone, or white space.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory paper surfaces, deep evergreen navigation shell, brass and brick used only as meaning.
Spectral for the numbers that decide; Archivo for everything the host reads and types.
Amounts right-aligned with dotted leaders; totals closed by a double rule.
Flat by default: hairlines and tone carry structure, shadow appears only on the sheet.
Rectangular controls with 3–4px corners; no pill chrome, no decorative gradients, no grain.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Brass appears only where money is projected or a contact was passed on; brick only where money is negative or a contact is discarded.

rules.name: The Tinted Ink Rule
rules.body: No grey text on a coloured surface: secondary text on the green rail is warm paper at reduced opacity.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every figure that can be compared sits in tabular lining numerals and on a right edge.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings carry themselves. There is no small tracked label above a page title.

rules.name: The One Elevation Rule
rules.body: Declare elevation once per surface: either a hairline or a shadow, never both.

dos: Do right-align every comparable amount and put a dotted leader between its label and its figure.
Do separate blocks with a 1px hairline or paper tone before reaching for a shadow.
Do keep labels at 0.75rem/600/0.08em uppercase and never below 11px.
Do set totals in Spectral and working numbers in Archivo with tabular figures.
Do draw icons as 1.5px-stroke SVG at 18–19px.
Do compress empty calendar days to one line.
donts: Don't use cream gradients, noise overlays or striped gradients as texture.
Don't rotate labels into stamps, or use unicode glyphs as icons.
Don't use pill-shaped buttons or floating circular actions.
Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
Don't colour the left edge of a card, or nest a panel inside a panel.
Don't show grey text on the green rail.
Don't spend Bosco on large content-area fields.
